symptom: Login/status queued behind slow disconnect started after cancel, cover, owner change or background; disposal caused setState after dispose.
rootCause: Screen checked epoch only after active requests returned; deferred admission captured no epoch and started methods with unconditional setState. Busy was not set until deferred work started.
fix: One _queueWork admission helper captures existing epoch, sets busy immediately, rejects repeated retained callbacks and checks mounted/epoch before executing. All3 login/status entry buttons use it. Existing bridge/account/session authorities unchanged.
